thread:
Maya (partnerships): Quick sync request — want to align on Q1/Q2 availability windows for H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi for marketplace onboarding. Can we call out blockers (firmware, image tags, pricing) and preferred announcement cadence?
Tom (platform): +1. We need concrete dates for when partner images are in our lab so marketplace onboarding can start.
Lina (solutions-eng): FYI SIs are asking for certified driver combos and a migration guide. They want early access to perf baselines.
Raj (eng-ml): From runtime side, MI300 perf numbers are still flaky on long sequences — need a driver firmware tweak from partner. Pinged HW team yesterday.
Maya (partnerships): @Tom do you have ETA on partner images? Also are we planning a joint announce or staggered partner waves?
Tom (platform): Partner images: Nvidia H200/H100 images expected in lab week of 2026-05-18; AMD MI300 images currently targeted week of 2026-06-01 (pending firmware). Gaudi vendor images are ready but we're waiting on signed licensing for marketplace.
Lina (solutions-eng): SIs: propose two waves — Wave A: H100/H200 + Gaudi quickstart (early adopters), Wave B: MI300 + B200 after final perf sign-off. That gives SIs breathing room.
Raj (eng-ml): Agree. Also need a small validation testlist for SI certification: token streaming, prefix caching, batch sizes 32/128, quantized int8 pass. I'll draft.
Maya (partnerships): Blockers: 1) MI300 firmware tweak (Raj noted). 2) Marketplace legal: vendor license addendum for Gaudi images. 3) Pricing & MSRP confirmation from partners — critical for marketplace listing.
Tom (platform): Add-on: image tags we need in CI: `redwood/v1.2.0-nvidia-h200`, `redwood/v1.2.0-amd-mi300`, and `redwood/v1.2.0-gaudi`. We can't onboard without those stable tags.
CI-bot: CI pipeline report: nightly lab build (nvidia-h200) succeeded 2026-04-28 03:14 UTC; amd-mi300 build failed at integration test step (kernel mismatch).
Raj (eng-ml): Thanks CI-bot — kernel mismatch is the firmware issue I flagged. I'm escalating to vendor eng.
Lina (solutions-eng): For SI onboarding checklist, we need: 1) image tags + docs, 2) perf baselines (p95 latency + throughput) for recommended batch sizes, 3) upgrade notes for existing customers. I'll draft template and share.
Maya (partnerships): Announcement cadence thought: do short embargoed partner brief for press/marketplace on day 0 for Wave A; internal SI enablement kits + playbooks on day -7; Wave B announced once MI300 firmware sign-off is green. Thoughts?
Tom (platform): That works. Request: lock the final image tags and marketplace SKU names at least 10 business days before public announce to avoid rollback churn.
Raj (eng-ml): Can vendors commit to a test firmware by 2026-05-15? Without that MI300 remains a risk.
Maya (partnerships): I'll push partners for firm commitments. Lina, please prep SI playbook with clear cutover steps and rollback plan.
Lina (solutions-eng): On it. ETA for playbook draft: 2026-05-03.
Tom (platform): I'll create a short runbook for marketplace ops: listing checklist, pricing fields, legal flag, image verification steps. Will share as a gist.
Maya (partnerships): Next steps:
- Maya: chase partner firmware & MSRP (by 2026-05-07)
- Raj: testlist + failing case triage (by 2026-05-01)
- Lina: SI playbook draft (2026-05-03)
- Tom: marketplace runbook + lock image tag policy (2026-05-05)
Please react with :thumbsup: when you ack.
Tom (platform): :thumbsup:
Lina (solutions-eng): :thumbsup:
Raj (eng-ml): :thumbsup:
Maya (partnerships): If partners give the firmware commit and legal signs the Gaudi addendum, we aim for a Wave A soft launch (limited GA in marketplace) by 2026-05-25 and full public announce for Wave A on 2026-06-01. Wave B tentative target 2026-07-10 pending MI300 sign-off.
Tom (platform): Noted. I'll calendar a dry-run deploy on 2026-05-20.
CI-bot: Reminder: scheduled lab maintenance on 2026-05-12 02:00-06:00 UTC — expected downtime for hardware validation.
Raj (eng-ml): Heads-up: some perf regressions appear only under our real workload traces. We'll run a 24h soak post-firmware to be safe.
Lina (solutions-eng): Putting tentative SI training sessions week of 2026-05-26 — will confirm once Wave A dates locked.
Maya (partnerships): Great. I'll consolidate and send a partner-facing note after partners confirm firmware/pricing. Thanks everyone.
Tom (platform): Thanks.
Lina (solutions-eng): Thanks!
Raj (eng-ml): Thanks, closing loop.
